scope.denominator: Named group controls on one adopted movie; neither all registered techniques nor all selected effects across the 30-condition matrix.

requiredIdentityChecks: Actual final video SHA-256 and frozen reference/audio SHA-256
Actual selected plan hash and full output frame count; exclude preview groups
Native original/ON whole RGBA hashes at same timestamps, dimensions and FPS
Exact decoded PTS correspondence for original, ON, OFF, ON_REPEAT
Original-vs-ON encoding variance and ON-repeat encoding variance both used, no noise threshold relaxation

classificationRules.VERIFIED_COMPOSITE_CONTRIBUTION: Named hook contributes beyond max(1,3*max(original-vs-ON noise,ON-repeat noise)); does not certify operator semantics.
classificationRules.VERIFIED_INTENT: Requires existing measurable intent target, sign/direction and execution interval matched to actual decoded artifact, separate from contribution.
classificationRules.NOT_APPLICABLE: Requires selected-plan and executed-branch evidence of no applicable intent; global dispatch/equal frames alone insufficient.
classificationRules.CONFOUNDED: Effect visible but independent intended target/direction not identified, or another coupled component is disabled with the hook.
classificationRules.UNMEASURED: Missing target/phase/independent semantic observation or unfinished controls.
classificationRules.FAILED: Applicable measurable intent demonstrably absent/wrong in decoded final movie; not mere small/no group pixel difference.

knownControlLimits: backgroundComposite removes nested grammar/camera/accent background dependencies and is a composite treatment, not isolated attribution to each nested effect.
cameraAt control can have no visual contribution when adopted grammar path uses its own focus; inspect actual execution before declaring selected camera failed.
No hook invocation counter is currently recorded except temporal parameterTrace; selection and Native ON/OFF equality cannot establish execution of every branch.
One case cannot supply all-matrix selected-intent coverage.
